resources.string: Flip Mini OS navigation and video controls

Optional cover screen controls for Back, Home, Recents and user-triggered TikTok and Instagram navigation. The service examines the active app’s accessible button labels only when a control is pressed. It does not store or transmit content.
Optional cover rotation keepalive. Restarts a rotation overlay after the cover wakes. It does not read screen content, button text, or app data; it does not perform gestures or transmit anything.
